raw.query:
WITH current_dim AS (
  SELECT run_id
  FROM provenance.v_dim
  WHERE is_current = true AND superseded_by IS NULL
), winsched AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(encoder_delay_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE arm = 'ctrl_aic') AS aic_p99_ms,
    MAX(encoder_delay_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE arm = 'treatment_vllm') AS vllm_p99_ms,
    BOOL_AND(queue_divergent = false) AS both_non_divergent,
    MAX(provisioned_worker_seconds) AS provisioned_worker_seconds,
    COUNT(DISTINCT provisioned_worker_seconds) AS distinct_worker_second_values
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_stats
  WHERE scenario = 'winsched'
), owning AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS current_pool_latency_rows
  FROM current_dim d
  JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l USING (run_id)
  WHERE l.is_current = true
    AND l.pool = 'encoder'
    AND l.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay'
    AND l.p99_ms IN (589.301, 605.612)
), priced AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_current_cost_ratio_rows
  FROM current_dim d
  JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio c USING (run_id)
  CROSS JOIN winsched w
  WHERE c.is_current = true
    AND c.numerator_worker_seconds = w.provisioned_worker_seconds
)
SELECT w.aic_p99_ms, w.vllm_p99_ms, w.both_non_divergent,
       w.provisioned_worker_seconds, w.distinct_worker_second_values,
       o.current_pool_latency_rows, p.matching_current_cost_ratio_rows
FROM winsched w CROSS JOIN owning o CROSS JOIN priced p
